notes: Wood-Ridge is a fully built-out municipality. DCA Present Need = 17 (rehab via Bergen County Home Improvement Program); Prospective Need = 130 (accepted DCA figure). Vacant Land Adjustment yields RDP = 0, making Fourth Round Unmet Need = 130. The Borough has 151 affordable units already constructed in the Wesmont Station redevelopment (Avalon Bay/100 Rosie Square: 47 units, 2012; The Willows at Wesmont Station/Ingerman/100 Johnson Drive: 104 units, 2015) under a 2008 Settlement Agreement with FSHC. With prior-round bonus credits, Borough claims 193 credits to apply against cumulative Prospective Need of 338 (prior rounds + 4th round). Unmet Need addressed through: (a) applying 193 existing credits, and (b) an inclusionary zoning ordinance (20% set-aside for ownership, 15% for rental) for any future 5+ unit multifamily development or redevelopment. No new greenfield inclusionary/100%-affordable sites are identified because RDP=0. The plan documents a filed Settlement Agreement (2008) with FSHC that is the operative compliance mechanism.
